_comment: The battle panel's shield rings, palette indices 0x50 (innermost of the ramp) to 0x57 (outermost): work order 258. Empty means the game's own colours, so the panel matches the original pixel for pixel. A mod replaces this file in the player's mod folder (files/screens/combat/assets/shield_colours.json) and names any of the eight as "0x50": "#rrggbb" or [r, g, b]; the green is still grown from the outline, only its colours change.
